title: EMM sublayer states in the UE

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where the UE is not registered with the network and has no EMM context established.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State where the UE is registered with the network and has an established EMM context.

entities.name: EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED
entities.description: State where the UE has initiated a tracking area updating procedure but has not yet received a response.

entities.name: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: State where the UE has initiated a service request procedure but has not yet received a response.

relations.description: Transition from EMM-DEREGISTERED to EMM-REGISTERED state upon successful registration.
Transition from EMM-REGISTERED to EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED state when initiating a tracking area update.
Transition from EMM-REGISTERED to EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state when initiating a service request.
